findings.text: Finding 1 (must-fix-before-live): the live edge is non-functional as wired - build_live_adapter's adapters do not implement _find_child or _set_watchers (base NotImplementedError only), so a live projection raises before any write. No active leak in the committed state. Fix at the live-activation step: implement find_child/find_epic/set_watchers on the live provisioner (like the WARP-0614 codified live methods).

Finding 2 (must-fix-before-live, central RULE #3 risk): declared-scope redaction is not a backstop. Raw secret literals and undeclared operating data in the bound decision's free text (summary, dead_end) reach the brief unredacted. Before live projection: constrain/allow-list the rendered free text, or make redaction fail-closed on undeclared secret-shaped tokens, not only declared terms.

Finding 3 (relevant once live): the live _comment never dedups by key, so live re-runs accumulate the brief/NG4 comments (inherited mirror posture). Address when the live projection is wired (key-based dedup or a bounded projection cadence).

Finding 4 (minor, defense-in-depth): the create_or_update_child fields (warp_request, warp_touchpoint) and the live comment-key marker bypass redact() - structural/controlled values (rid + closed-vocab status), low residual, worth closing for symmetry with the redacted title/brief.
